name: Panes
description: Control Windows desktop computers with PowerShell, screenshots, mouse/keyboard, file transfer and private viewer links. Local `panes-mcp` stdio server, installed with `python -m pip install "panes[mcp] @ https://usepanes.com/sdk/panes-0.1.3-py3-none-any.whl"`; requires `PANES_API_KEY` and prepaid credit for running computers.
